issue_context.title: Missing Socket.UseOnlyOverlappedIO functionality?
issue_context.body:
This comment in the UseOnlyOverlappedIO setter suggests it's a nop because we don't support DuplicateAndClose:
https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/blob/15ec69e47b4dc56098e6058a11ccb6ae4d5d4fa1/src/libraries/System.Net.Sockets/src/System/Net/Sockets/Socket.cs#L325-L329

But DuplicateAndClose was implemented here:
https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/pull/1858

Either the setter needs to be implemented, or the comment needs to be updated.
comments: @karelz, you noted that the comment needs to be updated and added an "easy" label, but there's no indication of what the comment should be changed to.

This property was used in Framework to prevent assigning completion ports to the socket, in order to allow sockets being duplicatable after performing (async) operations. The .NET core windows async PAL is based on IOCP all the way, and it's unlikely we want to change this.

We should replace outdated statements in the comment with a text similar to the explanation above. This is on my list.

review_comments: Do we have any tests that validate it defaults to false and that the setter is a nop?
